نتذاكر (form VI)
# نَتَذَاكَرُ (nataḏākaru) /na.ta.ðaː.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# نُتَذَاكَرُ (nutaḏākaru) /nu.ta.ðaː.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# نَتَذَاكَرَ (nataḏākara) /na.ta.ðaː.ka.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# نُتَذَاكَرَ (nutaḏākara) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
